author: TEDx Talks
description:
Are we all just part of a massive, unconsented digital experiment? In this thought-provoking talk, we dive into the dark side of human curiosity and the history of research ethics. From the tragic lessons of the past to the modern reality of "I Accept" buttons, discover how tech platforms are testing on us every day—and why we need to bring human ethics back into the digital age. Dr. Christina Giakoumaki is an Assistant Professor in Communication at Deree–The American College of Greece and Graduate Program Coordinator of the MA in Digital Communication & Social Media. A researcher by training and a rule-examiner by instinct, she has spent over a decade studying how people are persuaded, manipulated, and moved; in advertising, on social media, and increasingly, by artificial intelligence. 
 
Her work has been published in Q1 and Q2 peer-reviewed journals and presented at the American Marketing Association and the British Academy of Management. She holds a PhD in Marketing and Communica
title: Do not experiment on humans (unless they click accept)  | Christina Giakoumaki | TEDxDeree ACG

description: In this talk, Spyros Kottoris shares his personal journey through major career pivots and economic collapse to reveal why adaptability is the ultimate skill for navigating an uncertain world. Learn the three rules of adaptability: surfing disruption, finding your core purpose, and recognizing patterns in the chaos. Discover why confidence doesn't come before change, but is what remains after you survive it. Spyros Kottoris is an International Learning & Development Strategist, Sustainability & ESG Expert, and ICF Certified Executive Coach with more than 20 years of international experience designing learning and business transformation solutions across 14 countries and 12 industries. As the founder of Conferia Academy Global, he specializes in leadership development, ESG awareness, business strategy, and people transformation for multinational organizations and senior executives. His work focuses on helping organizations strengthen human-centered skills, leadership culture, and sustai
title: 3 rules of adaptability | Spyros Kottoris | TEDxDeree ACG

description: Ciprian Borșan explorează felul în care pierderile, traumele și crizele pot deveni resurse pentru reconstrucție, atât personală, cât și colectivă. Pornind de la propria experiență și de la vulnerabilitățile societății românești, el vorbește despre creșterea post-traumatică, puterea comunității și nevoia de a transforma durerea în acțiune. Mesajul său ne provoacă să privim altfel momentele dificile: nu doar ca răni pe care le purtăm, ci ca puncte din care putem construi sens, conexiune și o moștenire care rămâne. Ciprian Borșan este antreprenor, specialist în marketing și constructor de comunități, preocupat de impactul pe care mediul de business îl poate avea asupra societății. Este CEO și co-fondator Harpoon Marketing, curator TEDxBaiaMare și președinte fondator al Maramureș Business Club. De asemenea, este președinte RBL Maramureș și membru în Boardul Romanian Business Leaders. Cu experiență în mediul corporatist, antreprenorial și non-profit, Ciprian și-a construit parcursul la int
title: Cum se construiește o moștenire din pierdere | Ciprian Borșan | TEDxCopou

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if one of the most powerful forms of prevention is helping people feel like they belong?

Through stories from her mother's kitchen table, conversations through FirstLink and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, and her own experience with grief, Jennifer Illich explores how human connection shapes our lives. This talk challenges the idea that people need perfect words or solutions and instead highlights the power of creating belonging, staying present, and making room for one more chair.

At its heart, this is a talk about the energy that exists between us and the impact of helping people feel seen, valued, and connected. Jennifer Illich is the Executive Director of FirstLink, a nonprofit organization providing 24/7 crisis support, suicide prevention, and connection to community resources across North Dakota and parts of Minnesota. She has spent more than a decade leading efforts to strengthen how communities respond to people experiencing crisis, including through the 988 Suicide
title: Make Room for One More Chair | Jennifer Illich | TEDxFargo

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Most Americans spend decades working for companies, yet few ever get the opportunity to own part of one. That simple difference often explains why some workers build lasting wealth while others struggle to get ahead.

In this TEDxFargo talk, Tammy Miller explores the transformative power of employee ownership—a model that gives employees the opportunity to share in the value they help create. Employee ownership may be one of the most scalable and inclusive wealth-building opportunities in America. As the nation faces a historic transfer of business ownership, it presents a rare opportunity to broaden prosperity, preserve local businesses, strengthen communities, and reimagine what it means to achieve the American Dream.
 Tammy J. Miller is a business executive, board leader, and public servant dedicated to helping organizations, communities, and individuals reach their full potential.

Miller previously served as the 39th Lieutenant Governor of North Dakota, where she championed econo
title: The American Dream needs more owners | Tammy Miller | TEDxFargo

author: TEDx Talks
description: Mental health awareness has changed the conversation, but what if it’s time for the movement to evolve? Through an unexpected friendship and years of work in suicide prevention, Haley DeGreve explores what we may be getting wrong about mental health awareness and why the future of the movement depends less on what we know and more on how we show up for one another. Haley DeGreve is a Communications Manager at John Deere and the founder of The Gray Matters Collective, a national nonprofit she launched in 2018 while still a student at Augustana College. What began as a campus initiative has grown into a movement recognized by the University of Michigan Depression Center, offering hope and healing to thousands. A 2020 graduate with degrees in Marketing and Communication Studies, Haley has become a leading voice in youth mental health and suicide prevention. She has spoken at schools, workplaces, and community events, reaching over 50,000 people worldwide with her message of resilience. H
title: Rethinking mental health awareness | Haley Degrave | TEDxFargo

description: This talk covers the possibilities available when people connect the right way. Megan Burke Roudebush, global secure connectivity expert and entrepreneur, highlights how thoughtful questions make the potential of human connection limitless. By pivoting from "no" to something else, Roudebush draws on how her experience as an AP-trained child journalist taught her to ask the right questions at the right time. Megan Burke Roudebush is the Founder and CEO of keepwith®, a relationship technology company built around helping people create meaningful, real-world connections. An attorney, business leader, former Chief Compliance Officer, and lifelong relationship-builder, Megan began her career as a child journalist traveling the world with Children’s Express News Service. After moving to Chicago without knowing anyone, she developed a deliberate approach to networking that grew into a global speaking career—and eventually a company. A 2019 Shark Tank audition became the catalyst for Megan to
title: Limitless connectivity: Infinite potential of human connection | Megan Burke Roudebush | TEDxFargo

description: Medicine and healing are often discussed as universally understood concepts, but they can look vastly different from one perspective to another. In his talk, Rotshennón:ni Two-Axe discusses how healing exists in the space between Western medicine and Indigenous knowledge. Drawing on his work in emergency care and his studies in medicine he describes the intersection between two systems of care: community-rooted Onkwehón:we understandings of health and Western medical practice.  Rotshennon:ni Two-Axe (meaning he is happy), is a second-year medical student at McGill University who is a part of the turtle clan from the Kanien’kehá:ka nation in Kahnawake. Outside of being a medical student at McGill, Rotshennon:ni is a paramedic in his community and is part of a year-long kanien’kéha language program that is land, culture, and healing-based. His talk will bring together two worlds of medicine, the Indigenous and Western understandings of medicine. In Western medicine, illness is often som
title: Healing through two worlds of medicine | Rotshennon:ni Two-Axe | TEDxMcGill

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if the people we often underestimate have something essential to teach us about how to live? Through reflections on her relationship with her sister Kara, Alisha Espey explores what attention, ordinary moments and unconditional love can reveal about a meaningful life. In a culture shaped by distraction and striving, this talk invites us to pay attention and reconsider where wisdom lives. Alisha Espey is a storyteller, placemaking professional, and event organizer based in the Quad Cities. A believer in the power of connection and belonging, she leads programs and events for the Downtown Davenport Partnership. Inspired by her relationship with her sister Kara, her TEDx talk explores what people we often underestimate can teach us about attention, joy, and love. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Pay attention | Alisha Espey | TEDxDavenport

description: In this TEDx talk, Zachary encourages others to move beyond self-imposed limits and predetermined expectations, embracing growth through courage, persistence, and action. His message is simple: success begins when people stop waiting for the perfect moment and start taking the first step. Inspired by Reid Hoffman's quote, “If you aren’t embarrassed by the first version of your product, you shipped too late,” Zachary believes that progress comes from learning, adapting, and having the confidence to begin before everything feels perfect. As the 11th Grade Class President, Zachary is passionate about creating opportunities that empower others to succeed. With interests in finance, mortgages, equitable home buying, and addressing income inequality, he is committed to understanding and tackling the economic challenges that impact communities. Beyond leadership, he is currently involved in developing software for NMBNOW, combining technology and innovation to create meaningful solutions. Th

description: Filmarea într-una dintre cele mai securizate închisori din Europa, deținuți care oferă espresso și ciocolată unei echipe cu care nu vorbesc aceeași limbă, un bunic convins să se întoarcă într-un loc de care fugise toată viața. Pornind de la copilăria petrecută cu Alice in Wonderland ca refugiu și de la întrebarea unei fetițe de cinci ani, „unde se duc toate cuvintele pe care le spui la radio?", acest talk este despre poveștile care ne apropie și despre curajul de a rămâne curios acolo unde alții își întorc privirea. Pentru că nu împărțim aceleași vieți, dar trăim aceleași povești, iar distanța dintre noi e, de multe ori, mai mică decât credem. Mara Crăcăleanu este una dintre vocile emergente ale industriei cinematografice europene și fondatoarea Melancholia Pictures, companie prin care dezvoltă coproducții internaționale în Europa și America de Nord. title: Conexiunea umană există înaintea limbajului | Mara Crăcăleanu | TEDxIasi

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Anju Binani Damani, Founder & Creative Director of R And A International, shares her perspective on building fashion brands in a constantly evolving consumer market.

With a growing presence across India and international markets, R And A International operates across multiple fashion categories through brands including Blue Kids, Miska, B Kids, and Blue Boys. At the heart of the business is an understanding of what consumers want, how preferences change, and how brands can stay relevant while continuing to grow.

In this conversation, Anju discusses the intersection of creativity and entrepreneurship, the importance of understanding people and market trends, and the process of developing fashion brands that balance quality, comfort, contemporary design, and commercial relevance.

Her journey offers insights into what it takes to build and adapt consumer brands, identify opportunities, and expand a business beyond geographical boundaries.

#AnjuBinaniDamani #FashionBusiness #Entrepren
title: The Importance of Self-belief | Anju Binani Damani | TEDxFOT

author: TEDx Talks
description: Pentru unii, o piesă e doar un refren de la radio. Pentru un artist, e o bucată de viață. Pornind de la o fetiță de patru ani care ținea telecomanda pe post de microfon în Chișinău și ajungând la discurile de platină, acest talk este despre drumul pe care nu îl vede nimeni: obstacolele, frica de a nu reuși, cele două vieți paralele și piesa refuzată de trei ori care avea să schimbe totul. Pentru că oamenii nu se conectează cu perfecțiunea, ci cu adevărul, iar răbdarea nu înseamnă să aștepți, ci să continui să construiești chiar și când nu vezi niciun rezultat. Rădăcinile nu se văd, dar ele susțin tot ce rezistă în timp. Misha Miller este cântăreață și compozitoare moldoveancă, cu studii la Universitatea „Alexandru Ioan Cuza" din Iași (Finanțe și Politologie), care s-a impus pe scena muzicală europeană cu hituri precum „Un Minut" (#1 Shazam România, piesa anului 2023 la radio) și „Bam Bam" alături de Alex Velea. Cu colaborări internaționale ce cumulează peste 100 de milioane de vizuali
title: Rădăcinile nu se văd | Misha Miller | TEDxIasi

description: Ca sportiv de performanță și ca părinte, ajungi să trăiești cu inima în afara corpului tău. Pornind de la accidentarea de la Campionatele Mondiale din 2017, de la pierderea mamei sale și de la reconstrucția care urmează fiecărei căderi, acest talk este despre ce ne unește pe toți dincolo de funcții, aparențe și filtre: faptul că toți iubim, toți pierdem, toți ne temem și toți avem momente în care trebuie să alegem dacă rămânem jos sau ne ridicăm din nou. Pentru că adevărata performanță nu este să fii cel mai bun din lume, ci să treci prin viață fără să-ți pierzi sufletul. Larisa Iordache este una dintre cele mai valoroase gimnaste ale României și un simbol al perseverenței în sportul de performanță. Cu un palmares impresionant la competițiile europene și mondiale, între care titlul european la bârnă, a reprezentat România la cel mai înalt nivel și a inspirat generații întregi prin ambiție, disciplină și curaj. Dincolo de rezultate, povestea ei este despre reziliență: a trecut prin acc
title: Ce nu se vede de pe podium | Larisa Iordache | TEDxIasi

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Esteban Carranza propone analizar la posible existencia de inteligencia no humana como un escenario de riesgo, no como una simple historia de ciencia ficción. Recorre avistamientos documentados, testimonios públicos e iniciativas institucionales para defender la necesidad de investigar sin estigma. Su pregunta central no es si debemos creer, sino si estamos preparados para lo extraordinario. Pensar escenarios, evaluar evidencia y planificar respuestas también es una forma responsable de proteger a la sociedad. Esteban Carranza Kopper es abogado y notario público con una destacada trayectoria en derecho de seguros y análisis de riesgo.

Socio de la firma RL Abogados, ha asesorado por más de 20 años a empresas locales e internacionales en temas regulatorios y negocios. Posee una Maestría en Derecho de Seguros de la University of Connecticut, donde fue premiado con honores. title: Pensemos lo impensable | Esteban Carranza | TEDxPuraVida

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Todos emprendemos viajes a lo largo de la vida. Algunos nos llevan a nuevos lugares. Otros, mucho más profundos, nos llevan a descubrir quiénes somos y qué somos capaces de construir a lo largo del camino.

En tiempos de incertidumbre, hay virtudes que pueden transformar nuestra manera de vivir, liderar y relacionarnos. Una de ellas es la longanimidad: la capacidad de sostener con paciencia, fortaleza y perseverancia aquello que verdaderamente importa.

¿Cómo sobrellevar las dificultades sin perder de vista nuestro propósito?
¿Cómo cultivar la paciencia y la fortaleza para atravesar los momentos difíciles?
¿Y qué sucede cuando aprendemos a confiar en los procesos, incluso cuando todavía no podemos ver sus resultados?

En esta charla, Estanislao Torres Del Santo nos invita a descubrir el poder de ser longánimes: una virtud que nos permite atravesar la incertidumbre, sostener nuestros propósitos y acompañar a otros con mayor comprensión y fortaleza.

Porque hay caminos que no se constru
title: El poder de ser longánimes | Estanislao Torres del Santo | TEDxCosquín

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Feathers, sequins and sky-high headdresses may be the hallmarks of the showgirl, but her legacy is woven from far more than sparkle. For generations, she has stood as a symbol of reinvention. Beneath the glamour runs a cultural lineage that stretches from the cabarets of 19th-century Paris, through Broadway’s Ziegfeld Follies and the stages of Las Vegas. Danielle Colby is a multifaceted television personality, burlesque entertainer, entrepreneur, and passionate collector, best known for her role on the History's hit reality series, American Pickers. Born on December 3, 1975, in Davenport, Iowa, Danielle grew up surrounded by her family's love for antiques and unique items. This early exposure sparked her lifelong interest in collecting and preserving history through artifacts.
Before her television debut, Danielle pursued various artistic and performance-based interests. She founded, produced and performed in a burlesque troupe based out of the Iowa and Illinois collective Mississippi
title: What is an ecdysiast and why does it matter? | Danielle Colby | TEDxDavenport

author: TEDx Talks
description: AI is now part of how millions of people find information, make decisions, and move through daily life, often before anyone has taught them how to question it. The danger is notthat people are careless. It is that AI may be the most confident, fluent, andhelpful tool we have ever encountered, yet it can be wrong in ways that leave no warning and no trace. Drawing on her work in Responsible AI, Padmini explores why AI literacy is no longer a niche skill, offering a simple framework to help people shift their relationship with AI from passive trust to active critical thinking. Because the future of responsible AI depends not just on how these systems are designed, but also on whether the people using them know when to question them. Padmini Soni is a Senior AI Strategist, Speaker, and Founder of Rezonance AI, where she helps organizations design and implement responsible AI solutions aligned withreal-world business goals. She also serves as the Head of Responsible AI Growth Strategy at
title: ‍Who Catches AI's Mistakes When You Don't Know What to Look For? | Padmini Soni | TEDxDavenport

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this powerful talk, Toni Rodolfo-Benson explores what happens when grief doesn’t arrive as a single loss but as a wave that keeps crashing. Drawing from her lived experience of losing her brother, best friend, and mother within a single year, Toni introduces the concept of compounding grief—a reality many people face but few have the language to describe. As a registered nurse, author, grief educator, and leadership coach, she bridges professional insight with raw human truth, revealing how grief affects not only our emotions but also our bodies, identities, relationships, and sense of purpose. Toni challenges cultural expectations surrounding grief—including the pressure to “move on,” return to normal, or hide our discomfort—and offers a more compassionate and realistic approach to healing. Through storytelling and practical wisdom, she shares what truly helps in the face of loss: permission, presence, and community.

 Toni Rodolfo-Benson is a Registered Nurse, former nursing dire
title: When Grief Keeps Coming: Navigating Compounding Loss | Toni Rodolfo-Benson | TEDxGreenhouse Road

author: TEDx Talks
description: Every day massive entertainment tours arrive in cities across the world and create unique settings, exciting memories, and miles of infrastructure out of thin air. International production professional Aiden Landman has spent his career backstage solving the high-stakes logistical puzzles of world tours. Now he is opening his technical rider for America’s cities of the future. Drawing from a high-stakes flight from Chicago to Paris, Landman explores how cutting the weight of stagnation and checklist expectation and embracing the lean, imaginative approach of a world-class production can enable cities to stop being fly-overs and start headlining in their own right. Aiden Landman is an international touring music professional, hobbyist cat farmer, amateur historian, and enthusiastic civic futurist. He’s flown around the world the long way. Twice. A proud product of western Illinois rural flatlands, Landman currently lives in the Quad Cities with his wife, Chelsea, and house cat, Ladybir
title: A music professional's guide to the cities of the future | Aiden Landman | TEDxDavenport

title: Ya Bir Yere Ait Değilsem? | Gülper Özdemir | TEDxAdana Women

description:
The wilderness may seem wild and distant, yet it holds a powerful thread that connects us all. From forests and oceans to the smallest living beings, nature reminds us that we are part of something larger than ourselves. This talk explores how our relationship with the natural world can inspire empathy, responsibility, and a deeper sense of shared humanity.
 Sonali Mohanty is a Social Science educator who is deeply passionate about humanities, nature, culture, and the intricate connections that shape human life. Through her work as a teacher, she encourages young minds to explore ideas beyond textbooks and understand the world through curiosity, empathy, and critical thinking. Her interests extend to history, society, culture, and the natural world, particularly the fascinating ways in which human stories and wilderness are interconnected.

title: The Wilderness that Connects Us | SONALI MOHANTY | TEDxApeejay School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Borders may separate countries, but they cannot separate human emotions. This talk explores how empathy, compassion, shared dreams, and acts of kindness transcend geography, culture, and nationality. It reminds us that beyond every border lies the same human desire to belong, connect, and be understood.
 Maria Ranjeetha Nisha is a dedicated school teacher and the Head of the Department of Social Science and Commerce. A disciplined, patient, and hardworking educator, she is guided by strong values and faith.

Beyond the classroom, she is passionate about sports, particularly athletics, which has taught her the importance of perseverance, discipline, and determination.

She strongly believes that distance should never come in the way of human connection. While technology helps us stay connected across distances, she believes that humanity gives those connections meaning.

Through her TEDx platform, she hopes to share a simple yet powerful message: stay connected with the people you love

description:
What if the connections between people could be understood through the lens of physics? From forces and fields to vibrations and interconnected systems, physics reveals how seemingly separate elements can influence one another. This talk uses scientific ideas as a metaphor for humanity, exploring how our actions, emotions, and relationships create invisible connections that ripple through the world around us.
 DEBASHIS DASH is a passionate Physics educator who believes that science is not merely a collection of formulas and theories, but a way of understanding the world and our place within it.

As a teacher, he enjoys making physics relatable, thought-provoking and connected to everyday human experiences. With a deep enthusiasm for teaching and scientific thinking, Debashis seeks to inspire curiosity and encourage people to look at familiar ideas from unfamiliar perspectives.

title: STRINGS OF HUMANITY FROM PHYSICS POV | DEBASHIS DASH | TEDxApeejay School Youth

description:
A single act of kindness can travel much farther than we imagine. One helping hand, thoughtful word, or compassionate gesture can inspire another, creating a ripple that touches lives beyond the moment. This talk explores how kindness echoes through people and communities, reminding us that even the smallest good deed can create a lasting impact.
 Meet Shrinika Parhi, twelve-year-old who believes that inspiration knows no age limit. Blending the heart of an artist, the grace of a dancer, the soul of a musician, and the power of a motivational speaker, she captivates audiences whenever she steps onto a stage or up to a canvas.

Through her unique perspective as a young creator, she inspires audiences of all ages to realize that empathy is the ultimate force for transforming our world. description:
Human beings are shaped by countless connections—with family, friends, strangers, communities, and the world around us. This talk explores one such connection and how even the smallest bonds can influence who we become. It reminds us that our lives are not lived in isolation; we are woven together through the relationships and moments that give our lives meaning.
 Barenya Mohanty is a dedicated and hardworking Class 7-D student with a keen interest in Science and English. He enjoys playing basketball and has a strong interest in esports.

A curious and enthusiastic learner, Barenya loves exploring new ideas and gaining knowledge. He strongly believes in the values of teamwork, hard work, and dedication.

Passionate about nature, Barenya deeply values the connection between nature and humanity. He believes that we must use nature’s resources wisely and work together to create a brighter, healthier, and more sustainable future for the next generation. This talk was given at a TEDx event

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In her talk, Fatima explores how our comfort zones can shape the way we see ourselves, our abilities, and the possibilities available to us. She reflects on the assumptions we develop from our surroundings and how those assumptions can quietly become limitations. By challenging the perspectives that keep us comfortable, she encourages us to question what we believe is possible and to step beyond the boundaries we have created for ourselves. Fatima Yousaf did not come from a family of Ivy League graduates. She came from a city where no one had gone to an Ivy League school — until her. When she became the first person from her city to be accepted to Brown University, she carried more than her own ambition through those doors; she carried proof that the ceiling is breakable.
At Brown, Fatima did not just study — she built. She founded institutions, led communities, conducted research, and asked the questions that matter: Who gets to decide? Who gets left out? And what do we do about it?
title: Comfort zones are perspective traps | Fatima Yousaf | TEDxKCAS Youth

description:
Failure is often seen as the opposite of success, but it can be one of its most powerful teachers. This talk explores how mistakes, setbacks, and disappointments build resilience, reveal new possibilities, and help us grow. By changing the way we view failure, we can turn setbacks into stepping stones toward meaningful success.
